Synopsis:
This occurs if the player has successfully convinced the orthon to let them stay in his lair. They did so by telling him they'd search the temple for a way of freeing him from his contract.If the player resolves the Last Justiciar contract, they can inform Yurgir. If they killed the justiciar, Raphael will appear and negotiate with Yurgir. If the player spared the justiciar, they can confront and fight Yurgir.

Cluster Contexts:
- SHA_Orthon.json: The player is meeting Yurgir the orthon in his lair after persuading him to let them stay by promising to search the Shar temple for a way to free him from his contract. Off‑screen the party has already dealt with the Last Justiciar in some way — if the Justiciar was killed Raphael may arrive to bargain, while if the Justiciar was spared the player can instead confront and fight Yurgir. Yurgir keeps a tamed beast named Nessa and admits he uses potions/displacer charms to enforce her loyalty; the player is objecting to that manipulation. This short exchange takes place during a fragile truce, with Raphael, Mol, or other consequences of prior encounters potentially relevant but not shown.
- LOW_HouseOfHope_YurgirFarewell.json: Dialogue after combat with Raphael. Happens only when Yurgir is an ally.
- SHA_LastJusticiar_RatsNegotiate.json: The player continues to kill the rats. The rats begin to group up and attempt to bargain with the player. Their memories are starting to converge into a single consciousness of the last dark justiciar. Some players who accepted a quest from the Orthon may realise there is a Dark Justiciar in hiding, amongst these rats. If the player repeatedly talks to the rats at this point without accepting a truce, they'll turn hostile.
- SHA_Orthon_TrespassLair.json: Dialogue with the Orthon, where he tells you it was ordered by Raphael to kill Ketheric's Dark Justiciars. The dialogue ends in combat, unless you succeed some very hard persuasions.Orthon is huge, forboding and loves a good fight. He speaks in a low rumble and is TERRIFYING.
- SHA_LastJusticiar_SpeakWithDead.json: The player turned the Last Justiciar back into a humanoid by killing his rats. The player then proceeded to kill the Last Justiciar and talk to him using Speak With Dead.The Last Justiciar witnessed the Orthon attack and has been using his rat form to hide for years

context: The player has already persuaded Yurgir the orthon to let them stay in his lair by promising to search the Shar temple for a way to free him from a binding contract, so this exchange takes place during a fragile truce. Off‑screen the party has already dealt with the Last Justiciar in some way — if the Justiciar was killed, Raphael may arrive to bargain; if the Justiciar was spared, the player might be able to confront and fight Yurgir instead. Yurgir keeps a tamed beast named Nessa and admits he uses potions/displacer charms to enforce her loyalty; the player is objecting to that manipulation. Yurgir is a huge, forbidding hunter who treats such measures as practical tools and speaks in a low, rumbling voice; other consequences of earlier encounters (rats, Raphael, Mol) may be relevant but are not shown.
